relations.relationship: Examines how the separate-spheres metaphor shaped both historical prescriptions and historians’ accounts of women.
relations.evidence_note: Primary printed pp. 9–11 and 38–39 read. The critique treats the metaphor as a historically located interpretive problem, not proof that women never faced exclusions or that spaces were never gendered.

relations.relationship: Investigates gendered citizenship through unequal civic burdens, exemptions and authority.
relations.evidence_note: Primary Kerber section of the Summer 2001 Bulletin talk, opening and the Reed/citizenship discussion. Robert Post’s separate introduction is not attributed to her. Historical legal examples are her account, not current-law certification.
